summary.plain: The French-led team of physicists running the EDELWEISS germanium dark matter search under a mountain in the French Alps.
summary.technical: Collaboration (French CNRS/IN2P3-led, with international partners) operating the EDELWEISS cryogenic germanium bolometer direct-detection programme at the Laboratoire Souterrain de Modane.
